tool_args.rationale: The observed s_grad reaches 2.44, above the specified 2.36 gray-zone gate. A high-gradient measurement is needed to identify the avalanche threshold and strength before fitting the forecast law.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the smooth square-root siphon immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot reaches the uncertified threshold gray zone and cannot identify a supercritical avalanche term.
The high-gradient probe directly discriminates the threshold mechanism at lower cost.
The pilot alone does not distinguish it reliably from the documented gradient-dependent siphon.
